[EN] Climbing through the Ranks
[ES] Ascendiendo en las filas
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] The road leads in all directions, but your path is to the east.
[ES] El camino lleva a todas partes, pero tu ruta es hacia el este.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] You are doing better than I expected.
[ES] Lo estás haciendo mejor de lo que esperaba.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "You can count on me."
[ES] "Puedes contar conmigo."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Gyebrik.
[ES] Habla con Gyebrik.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Obelisk Shard
[ES] Fragmento de obelisco
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Retrieve obelisk shards from the {@linkcreature:13#301194#stonebeaks} at the northeastern part of the Tower Base.
[ES] Recupera fragmentos de obelisco de los {@linkcreature:13#301194#stonebeaks} en la parte noreste de la base de la torre.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Got all of the shards. Now, inspect the obelisk and repair it.
[ES] Tengo todos los fragmentos. Ahora, inspecciona el obelisco y repáralo.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Finish the repairs.
[ES] Termina las reparaciones.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Mathar Spire
[ES] Aguja de Mathar
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Found Mathar Spire!
[ES] ¡Encontrada la Aguja de Mathar!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Climb up the vines to reach the Mathar Spire.
[ES] Trepa por las enredaderas para llegar a la Aguja de Mathar.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Gather the Skyreach Flower.
[ES] Recolecta la flor del cielo.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Thank you."
[ES] "Gracias."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Use the flower's or potion's effect to jump off the cliff safely. Then report to Jorhon.
[ES] Usa el efecto de la flor o de una poción para saltar del risco sin peligro. Luego, infórmale a Jorhon.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
